headline: United Therapeutics Misses Q3 Earnings Estimates Despite Revenue Beat
summary: United Therapeutics reported third-quarter revenue that exceeded analyst projections, though its earnings per share fell short of consensus estimates by $0.50.
why: Biopharmaceutical companies experience significant earnings volatility driven by research and development expenditures alongside commercial drug sales.

impacts.name: United Therapeutics
impacts.why: An earnings miss weighed against a revenue beat creates conflicting signals for equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Missing bottom-line profit expectations often triggers selling pressure, even when top-line revenue figures meet or beat forecasts.
